pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Blood Infusion$(): The power of dragon blood, infused into the blade.$(br2)Effect: Consumes dragon blood to apply effects to enemies:$(li)Fire Dragon Blood → Ignites$(li)Ice Dragon Blood → Frost$(li)Lightning Dragon Blood → Disarms$(br2)Synergy: Combine it with the $(l:traits/trait_dragon_blood_tank)Dragon Blood Tank$().
